title.zh: v0.7.3：磨砂修复与对比度整改
title.en: v0.7.3: glass fix and contrast pass

body.zh:
修复 v0.7.2 引入的磨砂回归：安装包里模糊完全不生效的问题已解决，模糊强度与饱和度恢复正常。没有背景图时磨砂滑块也能看出变化，主卡不透明度重新按侧栏派生。

全站正文对比度整改完成，四个主题下正文与弱化文字均达到 4.5:1。AI 会话改为按接口隔离，切换接口不再串会话。
body.en:
Fixed the frosted-glass regression from v0.7.2: blur works again in installed builds, with strength and saturation back to normal. The glass sliders now visibly change without a wallpaper, because the main card's opacity is derived from the sidebar again.

Body-text contrast was reworked across all four themes, so body and muted text now clear 4.5:1. AI conversations are isolated per endpoint, so switching endpoints no longer mixes sessions.
